description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans storage provider, specifically testing ADO.NET related functionality including storage hashing, grain ID conversions, and key formatting.

classes.name: AdotNetProviderFunctionalityTests
classes.description: Contains multiple unit tests evaluating ADO.NET storage provider behaviors such as hashing, ID conversions, and key formatting.

methods.name: AdoNetStorageProviderGrainTypeHashing
methods.description: Tests that the storage provider hashing function is thread-safe and consistent.

methods.name: LongGrainIdToN1KeyAreSame
methods.description: Validates that Long Grain ID correctly maps to N1 key representation.

methods.name: LongGrainIdToStringAreSame
methods.description: Checks that Long Grain ID converts properly to string representation.

methods.name: LongGrainIdWithExtensionAreSame
methods.description: Verifies that Grain ID with extension is correctly formatted with '#' separator.

methods.name: GuidGrainIdWithExtensionAreSame
